name: the simplest pattern
headline: The simplest *pattern*
sub: Overlooked, because it is so simple.
say: Underneath it all is one pattern. A tile has a name. What it holds is named by a fingerprint of its content. And what it holds can be more tiles, built the same way. That is all of it. A note, a website, a whole community: each is this one pattern, repeated. In technical terms, it is a content-addressed tree, where names point to signatures and every node has the same shape.
